candidate: H33a shared bitplane task-gradient preconditioner leave-one-node-out discriminator
purpose: Test whether one explicitly charged target-aligned global bitplane transfers a coordinatewise orientation relation from five MLP layer/role nodes to a sixth when it preconditions a basis-free synthetic task-gradient atom.

task_atom.formula: D_n(E) = NS5(gradient of fixed task loss with respect to W_n at W0)
task_atom.prompt_seed_and_targets: identical deterministic make_prompt policy used by the sealed synthetic-program family

sign_fit.target: six-node leading PC of the centered registered 239-state trajectory
sign_fit.normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for each canonicalized task atom and PC part
sign_fit.leave_one_out_rule: for heldout h, S_j = sign(sum over n != h of normalized(D_n)_j * normalized(U_n)_j); zero maps to +1
sign_fit.heldout_score: squared cosine after the heldout node's optimal scalar coefficient

routing_after_pass: Preregister one all-node-mask tangent audit covering the joint top PCs, untouched late updates, layer-6 A/B common path, and held-out innovation under the identical byte budget.
routing_after_failure: Close the exact one-shared-bitplane plus task-gradient hybrid and return to theory before selecting another ledger row.
